# Copilot instructions

Canonical project rules are in `.ai/`. Before proposing edits, use
`.ai/00-core.md`, `.ai/10-workflow.md`, `.ai/project/repo-map.md`, and only the
relevant stack profile. Follow `.ai/20-quality-gates.md` and
`.ai/25-test-coverage.md` for implementation and `.ai/30-security.md` at trust
boundaries.

When a task changes `SKILL.md` or a referenced resource, read and follow
`.ai/35-skills.md`. Treat it as a skill update, synchronize its artifacts,
validate it with available tooling, and do not install globally without an
explicit request.

Laravel hard rules: no database foreign key constraints; exactly one table per
migration file; create and test a Policy, Factory, and registered Seeder for
every new Eloquent model; synchronize Factory/Seeder when its contract changes;
keep internal integer `id` plus external UUID generated by shared
`App\Traits\UuidTrait`; make Filament Resources resolve record routes by UUID;
preserve dependent lifecycle through synchronous model events/Observers without
bulk delete bypasses; Filament must be version 5 or newer.

Prefer repository versions, patterns, scripts, and tests over generic examples.
Never fabricate command or test results.

Every behavior change requires meaningful tests. Default to at least 90% patch
coverage, prevent project coverage regressions, fully cover critical branches,
and require the Codecov comment/status for the current PR head.
